items.exampleEn: There are three benches near the bus stop.
items.exampleZh: 公車站附近有三張長椅。

items.exampleEn: There is a statue of a horse in the park.
items.exampleZh: 公園裡有一座馬的雕像。

items.exampleEn: The company sells its products worldwide.
items.exampleZh: 這家公司在全世界銷售產品。

items.exampleEn: The milk is in aisle five.
My grandparents live in the countryside.
Texas is a big state in America.
items.exampleZh: 德州是美國的一個大州。

items.sentenceZh: 下班後我們在市中心見面吧。

items.audioEn: It's raining, so let's go to the indoor pool.
items.audioZh: 在下雨，我們去室內游泳池吧。

items.sentenceEn: An old man is sitting on the bench.
items.sentenceZh: 一位老先生坐在長椅上。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't leave your bag in the aisle.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要把包包放在走道上。

items.stemEn: My parents moved to the ____ because they wanted a quiet life.
items.stemZh: 我爸媽搬到鄉下，因為他們想過安靜的生活。
這個品牌全世界都很有名。

items.passageEn: Last summer, Leo traveled around America. He visited three different states. In one big city, he walked around downtown and took photos of a famous statue. Then he spent a few days in the countryside. He often sat on a bench by a lake and read a book. "It's a very big country," he said.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，Leo 在美國各地旅行。他去了三個不同的州。在一個大城市裡，他在市中心四處走走，還拍了一座有名的雕像。接著他在鄉下待了幾天。他常坐在湖邊的長椅上看書。他說：「這真是個很大的國家。」

questions.questionZh: Leo 在大城市做了什麼？
options: 去飯店的室內游泳池游泳
和朋友一起在湖裡釣魚
每天沿著湖邊騎腳踏車

items.promptZh: 這家購物中心有一個室內遊樂場。
referenceEn: This mall has an indoor playground.
There is an indoor playground in this mall.
rubricZh: 「室內的」用 indoor，放在名詞前（例如 an indoor playground）

items.instructionZh: 用 country 造一個句子，說說你去過或想去的國家。
referenceEn: I want to visit a country in Europe someday.
Japan is my favorite country to visit.
rubricZh: country 是可數名詞（例如 a country、many countries）
時態配合句意（例如 want、is、have visited）
